summary: Lewis Hamilton faces Ferrari after his Singapore blunder handed Kimi Antonelli a chance to clinch the world championship at Austin, where the McLaren rookie sits on the brink of glory. Carlos Sainz and the Ferrari squad hunt redemption against a Mercedes team reeling from strategy miscalculation, while Racing Bulls' driver futures hang in the balance amid championship pressure. A victory for Antonelli in Texas would crown him champion and reshape the grid's power dynamics heading into the final races, cementing one of F1's most unexpected title triumphs.
